versions.changelog: Extended the map to its full functional urban area, so the outer suburbs and satellite towns people commute from are now on it, and added hospital demand, neighbourhood labels inside cities, and university attendance counted from day-attendance rather than total enrolment.
Added the first Ukrainian maps — Kyiv, Kharkiv, Lviv, Odesa, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, and Kryvyi Rih — with residents, workers, and demand for airports, ports, universities, and attractions.
